name: Cordless Pressure Washer Kit
subtitle: Portable washer with dual batteries
description: This cordless pressure washer kit uses dual 21V lithium-ion batteries and delivers up to 40 bar of pressure. The portable washer includes an 8 m hose, spray tips, foam lance, and carry case for cleaning cars, bikes, patios, and other outdoor surfaces.
story: Built for portable washing where a mains-powered machine may be inconvenient, this kit can draw fresh water from a tap or bucket. The 8 m high-pressure hose provides extra reach around vehicles and outdoor areas, while interchangeable 0°, 15°, and 25° spray tips offer different coverage patterns. A foam lance is included for applying cleaning foam. Quick-connect fittings support tool-free assembly, and the hard-shell carry case keeps the washer and accessories organized for storage or transport.
